title: Yellow Mirror
plot_overview: Two dark, bizarre tales follow a family confronting unsettling questions about what is real and who is in control. A defective lamp challenges a father’s understanding of reality, while an AI-powered tablet forms a bond with his young daughter and begins to control her.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like dark, bizarre animated stories about family and technology; Not for you if you prefer grounded plots or a consistently lighthearted tone.
review_summary: Pros: bizarre premise; two dark tales; family-focused story | Cons: unsettling tone; unusual concepts; limited context
